notes.raw:
\*Data except enthalpy of formation at 298 K estimated. 
Phase changes: 336.35 K, melting point of K; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 0.558$ kcal/mol. 
1043.7 K, calculated boiling point of K to ideal monatomic gas; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 19.038$ kcal/mol. 
Heat capacity (cal/mol·K) and enthalpy (kcal/mol) equations: 
298.15-2000 K: $Cp^{0} = 13.859 + 0.036 \times 10^{-3} T - 0.563 \times 10^{5} T^{-2}$ 
$H^{0}-H_{298}^{0}=13.859\times10^{-3}T+0.018\times10^{-6}T^{2}+0.563\times10^{2}T^{-1}-4.322$ 
Reaction equations (kcal/mol): 
298.15-336.35 K: $\Delta \mathrm{Hr}^{\circ} = -19.591 + 7.595 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} - 20.278 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 22.150 \mathrm{T}^{-1}$ 
$\Delta \mathrm{Gr}^{\circ} = -19.591 - 7.595 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} + 20.278 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 11.075 \mathrm{T}^{-1} + 24.971 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
336.35-1043.7 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -19.585 - 4.003 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} - 0.374 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 199.350 \mathrm{T}^{-1}$ 
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -19.585 + 4.003 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} + 0.374 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 99.675 \mathrm{T}^{-1} - 36.615 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
1043.7-2000 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -62.791 + 0.673 \times 10^{-3} T - 0.386 \times 10^{-6} T^{2} + 473.350 T^{-1}$ 
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -62.791 - 0.673 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} + 0.386 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 236.675 \mathrm{T}^{-1} + 37.144 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
Sources: Enthalpy of formation at 298 K from Farber (34). Other data are those estimated by Piper (100).
